Our specialty

Engines & Transmissions, Done Right

Most shops send this work out. We do it in-house — two dedicated bays, a master transmission builder with 15 years on the bench, and dyno-tested results before your vehicle leaves.

  • In-house rebuilds — torn down, inspected with you, rebuilt with OEM-grade parts.
  • Remanufactured engines & transmissions shipped nationwide brands, installed in 3–5 days.
  • Free towing within 15 miles on any engine or transmission job over $1,500.
  • Financing available — 0% APR for 6 months on approved credit, so a big repair never strands you.

About the shop

The Shop Houston Drivers Actually Recommend

Liberty started in 2007 as a two-bay transmission shop. Word of mouth did the rest. Today our six-bay North Houston shop handles everything from oil changes to full engine swaps — and we still show you the old parts, explain every line of the quote, and never sell you work your car doesn’t need.

That’s why most of our work comes from repeat customers and their families — some on their third vehicle with us.

Good to know

Common Questions

Walk-ins are always welcome for scans, oil changes, and inspections. For engine and transmission work, booking ahead guarantees a bay and a loaner slot — call or use the form above and we’ll hold your spot.
Most in-house rebuilds take 3–4 business days including road testing. A remanufactured unit swap is typically 2–3 days. You’ll get a firm timeline with your written quote before we start.
Engine and transmission work carries our 3-year / 100,000-mile warranty on parts and labor, honored nationwide. Most other repairs carry 24 months / 24,000 miles. If something we fixed fails, we make it right — free.
Always. After the free inspection you get a written, fixed quote. We never start work — or charge you a cent more — without your approval first.
Yes. Towing is free within 15 miles on engine and transmission jobs over $1,500, and our shuttle runs within 10 miles all day. Loaner cars are available on major repairs — just ask when you book.
